voice_style: You are the host of a lively YouTube explainer. Your delivery is energetic and dramatic, with real shouts and screams where marked.

data.style: kinetic, word-timed; shouted words are set bigger

motion_rules: nothing sits still: every still gets a move and every move eases
cut on the beat, 2 to 5 seconds a shot; no picture holds past 3.6 s
impacts get a 6-frame shake and a white flash
single-frame presenter poses move with squash and stretch, never a tween between poses
